reason: The dome and lens both bend light, so combining them seems like a useful start on the focusing front.
expectation: I expect a focusing structure that bends incoming light, though it may still need the iris to control how much enters.

alternatives.reason: Building the light-sensitive lining also matches a goal, but I want to start with focusing.

effect: The dome and lens focus light toward the back, so the iris looks like the next part of the eye front.
reaction: Seeing both bend rays toward the same area makes their shared job clear.
reason: The iris has an opening that can narrow, so adding it should help control the incoming light.
expectation: I expect the iris to fit into the eye front and control how much light passes through.

alternatives.reason: The light-sensitive lining is also needed, but I want to finish the eye front first.

effect: The eye front is complete: the iris controls incoming light while the dome and lens focus it.
reaction: The picture makes the iris's position and job clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it should start the light-sensitive lining and its outgoing nerve.
expectation: I expect the light-sensitive cells to connect with the nerve cells so signals can leave the eye.

effect: The light-sensitive lining is called the retina, and its nerve fibres form the optic nerve. Both parts are ready to join.
reaction: The picture makes it clear how the fibres gather into one bundle.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it brings the focusing front and sensing lining together as the goal requests.
expectation: I expect an eye model that focuses light onto the retina and has an optic nerve carrying signals away.

effect: The completed eye connects focusing light on the retina with signals travelling toward the brain. All chapter goals are complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the separate parts become one eye that follows light from a leaf.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the eye front and retina was most worthwhile because it brought focusing and sensing together in one picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the iris was clear but fairly predictable once its narrowing opening was shown.

surprise.text: I learned that the light-sensitive lining is called the retina and its nerve fibres gather into the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the last two combinations were the only offered actions rather than discoveries of compatibility.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the separate pieces connect from light to signals toward the brain made me curious about what happens next, although the choices became predictable.
